players.name: Cal Raleigh
players.summary: Off day for Seattle. Raleigh is mired in a 0-for-29 slump over his last 7 games.

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Phillies off day. Harper exited May 9 game with a migraine but was expected back before the off day.

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: 2-for-4, 2 R as Giants routed Dodgers 9-3; key single in the 7th-inning 5-run rally that broke a 3-3 tie.

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Mets off day before Tuesday's Tigers series. Scouts note lingering knee (PCL sprain) affecting his sprint speed.

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Tigers off day before opening 3-game series at Citi Field (starts May 12). McGonigle leads AL rookies in hits.

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: Cubs off day before road series at Atlanta (starts May 12). Chicago was shut out twice in last Rangers series.

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Padres off day after splitting 4-game home series vs Cardinals. Merrill drew a key IBB in Sunday's extra-innings walk-off win.

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Rested by manager Dave Roberts amid May slump (.614 OPS, no HR since Apr 15). Alex Call may see more playing time.

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: Ben Rice blasted 374-ft 2-run HR (13th of season) off Baltimore's Brandon Young in the 3rd; Yankees fell 3-2.

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Mets off day. Williams has 6 consecutive scoreless outings and 5 SV; ERA dropped from 10.29 peak to ~6.0.

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Phillies off day. Wheeler (1-0, 3.11 ERA) has made 3 solid starts since returning from thoracic outlet syndrome surgery.

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: On 15-day IL (retro May 7) with left elbow impingement (VEO/pitcher's elbow). Exited May 6 start early; timeline TBD.

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Reds off day Monday. Burns (3-3, 2.21 ERA) leads NL in pitching WAR; next start Tuesday vs Washington.

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Late scratch vs Arizona due to left side tightness; underwent imaging with results pending. Possible IL move.

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Not in Monday's rotation (Roki Sasaki started in 9-3 loss). Sheehan's next start projected for road trip to St. Louis.

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Not scheduled Monday; Brent Suter started for Angels in 7-2 loss to Cleveland. Detmers awaits next turn.
